fact: At a multi-country workshop in Dakar on 2-5 October 2023, Senegal's RNU is presented as holding 541,192 households, the targeting base for all safety-net projects under decree 2021-1052, with some 25 user programmes; a unique individual identifier to link institutions' databases is listed as a future need, not in place.
title: Atelier technique multi-pays sur les registres sociaux, 2-5 octobre 2023, Dakar
publisher: World Bank (Sahel Adaptive Social Protection Program) and WFP
